description:
Commercial auto, step 2 of 2: call it once, with the collected commercial_next_question returned when ready_to_submit was true. Do not call it again after it answers: a repeat is usually answered with the earlier request and already_received: true, but that is not guaranteed, and a second call can file a second request.

Sends the intake to Sigo, where a licensed agent reviews it and follows up by email. It is a request for a quote, not a quote: it returns no price, selects no policy, takes no payment and binds no coverage. Say `message` and `disclaimer` as written, and offer `form_url` with `form_note` for a customer who wants to add their vehicles and drivers now.

A refusal comes back with a code, a message for the customer and a next_step for you. One that says the request did not reach Sigo carries form_url: never tell the customer it was received.

collected.description: The `collected` commercial_next_question returned when ready_to_submit was true.

locale.description: The language the customer is writing in. Set it from their own messages: the questions come back in it, and the request is filed in it so the Sigo agent follows up in it.

name: submit_commercial_application

already_received.description: True when this business had already sent the same request: the earlier one is answered again, and no second one was filed.

disclaimer.description: The notice every quote is subject to. Say it as written; it is the disclosure itself.

form_note.description: The line to give the customer with form_url.

form_url.description: The website's full commercial form, in the customer's language.

message.description: What to tell the customer, as written.

reference.description: Sigo's reference for the request. Not a quote and not a policy number.

status.description: Sigo has the request. A Sigo agent follows up; nothing was quoted here.

title: Send a business's commercial auto request to Sigo
